independent_float_check.method: SciPy digamma, spherical_jn and spherical_in; midpoint weight and exact analytic constraint projections, independent special-function implementation from Arb0f1 route.

code_audit: Positive-part branch replaces intervals crossing zero by an enclosure[0,upper]; intervals entirely nonpositive contribute zero.
Even and odd projected Legendre coefficients use the full exact moment functions; no approximate finite Gram inverse is substituted.
Weighted Gram accumulation encloses the same midpoint matrix; interval LDL requires every pivot strictlypositive.
Plane-tail double factorial and geometric ratio match the full omitted Legendre mode bound.
Quadrature and truncation budgets are outward evaluated; positivity is decided by interval inequalities, not by floating eigenvalues.
Argument guards reject odd ranks, nonpositive node counts and precision below64bits before output creation.
limitations: The certificate is restricted to support(-1/2,1/2), zero mean and both pole moments.
Replay agreement is a consistency check; proof of the inequalities comes from outward arithmetic and the analytic remainder argument.
Matrix hashes differ with precision and are identity records, not mathematical evidence.
No claim of unweighted positive-part domination is audited or established.
